desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Company has opened a new retail store of Style Baazar at Panki, Uttar Pradesh, today.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Company has opened a new retail store of Style Bazaar at VMR Mall, Gajuwaka, Andhra Pradesh, today.

Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the Company has opened two new retail stores of Express Baazar at Ghosh Para Road, Barrackpore and HCP Road, Chanchal, West Bengal, today.
Please find letter attached intimation related to Annual General Meeting to be held on September 25, 2026.
